_README: DECLARED CO-WRITER GROUPS for check_asset_catalogue_contract.py rule X-01. The contract's de-duplication invariant (ASSET_CATALOGUE_CONTRACT_v1_0.md §4.9) is one authoritative producer per (target_table × generation × natural-key partition) — NOT one per table. Several tables legitimately carry more than one writer. This file records those groups, measured from the live registry on the dated baseline below, so that X-01 can distinguish a DECLARED co-writer set from an UNDECLARED collision. WHAT A GROUP HERE DOES *NOT* ASSERT: that the co-writers' natural-key partitions are disjoint. Nothing in the schema records a partition today, so that assertion has no detector and stays contract rule C-25, permanently `not_checkable` until a column exists (§10.3). Listing a table here means 'these producers are known and expected', never 'these producers are correct'. X-01 fails on (a) any multi-producer table absent from this file and (b) any NEW producer appearing in a table that IS here — the group is frozen at its measured membership, the same discipline as migration_number_legacy_duplicates.json: the backlog can be paid down, never silently grown.
